en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, neoclassical military barracks complex standing on open sandy ground with low vegetation in the foreground and a cloudy sky above. The large, multi‑story buildings have a central portico with columns and symmetrical wings. Handwritten text along the bottom edge identifies the location, and a photographer's credit appears on the right.
